strategy: Navigate toward the goal direction (ahead, left, or right) whenever it can be done safely, prioritizing forward movement and avoiding obstacles.

decisions.condition: The robot can move forward without encountering an obstacle.
The robot can move left without encountering an obstacle and the goal direction is left.
The robot can move right without encountering an obstacle and the goal direction is right.
The robot cannot move forward, left, or right without encountering an obstacle.

stop_condition: The robot must issue STOP when it cannot move forward, left, or right without encountering an obstacle.
